conditions: User is signed in with items in the cart
User opens the side menu and taps Reset App State
items.expected: The Reset App State menu item is clicked and the menu closes; the cart badge is no longer visible on the products page

conditions: User opens the side menu and taps Logout
items.expected: The Logout menu item is clicked and the session ends; the sign-in page is displayed

conditions: User presses the browser back button to navigate to the product list
items.expected: The back navigation is attempted; the product list page is not shown and the sign-in page is displayed instead

conditions: Side menu is open on the inventory page
axe-core scans the menu element for WCAG A and AA violations
items.expected: No axe-core violations are reported (violations.map(v => v.id).sort() equals [])

conditions: User attempts to access the product list URL directly
items.expected: The direct navigation attempt is made and the session is found invalid; the product list is not shown and the sign-in page is displayed
